meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 装上后,面对你提出的任何问题,Claude 会召唤 4-6 个思维风格各异的「议员」(如建筑师、逆向者、经验主义者等)轮番发表观点,最后整合出共识、核心分歧、盲点、行动建议与把握程度。
howto.when: 当用户要求多角度思考、议会式讨论或魔鬼代言人分析,或面临两难、复杂选择等无明确答案的情况时触发。

say.text: 用议会模式帮我分析:该不该辞职创业?
say.note: Claude 会组建多角色议会并输出综合结论。

say.text: 让不同思维角色讨论这个产品的设计方案。
say.note: 会按问题类型挑选匹配的思维原型。

say.text: 来一次快速议会,评估两个 offer 的利弊。
say.note: 快速模式用 3 位成员,回答更简短。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude deliberates your question via 4-6 thinking archetypes (Architect, Contrarian, etc.), each giving stance, reasoning, key risks, and insights, then synthesizes convergence, core tension, blind spot, recommended path, and confidence level.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests for diverse viewpoints, council/panel discussion, devil's advocate analysis, or on phrases like 'council mode'; also when facing dilemmas, trade-offs, or complex choices without obvious answers.

say_en.text: Use council mode to analyze: should I quit my job to start a company?
say_en.note: Claude forms a council and outputs a synthesis.

say_en.text: Have different thinking archetypes discuss this product design.
say_en.note: Matches archetypes to the question type.

say_en.text: Run a quick council comparing the two job offers.
say_en.note: Quick mode uses 3 members with shorter replies.
